console.name: body-type
console.title: Body Type
console.description: The body types each step of the routes has been reached with

filter.label: query
filter.description: Filters the routes matching by route id, route uri, and source location

varied.label: query
varied.description: Whether to include only the steps that have been reached with more than one body type

source.description: The source location (only present when known)

line.description: The source line number (only present when known)

code.description: The code representation of this processor

bodyTypes.description: The body types this processor has been reached with, across the messages, in the order first seen: more than one means the type varied

bodyKinds.description: The kinds of the bodies this processor has been reached with: null, payload (text, bytes, a stream or a file), data (a Map, a List or an object) or iterator. More than one means the step needs attention

steps.description: The steps of the route that a message has reached, with their body types

routes.description: The routes with a step that a message has reached (the message history records the body types, such as in the dev profile)
